gold_sql: SELECT cgpa FROM students WHERE student_id = '24ENTC015'
SELECT c.title FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c USING (course_code) WHERE e.student_id = '23CE001' AND e.status = 'ongoing' AND e.attendance_pct < 75
SELECT SUM(amount_due - amount_paid) FROM fee_ledger WHERE student_id = '23IT016' AND academic_year = '2026-27'
SELECT SUM(o.offers) FROM placement_offers_by_branch o JOIN placement_drives d USING (drive_id) WHERE d.academic_year = '2022-23' AND o.branch = 'IT'
SELECT company, package_lpa FROM placement_drives WHERE academic_year = '2025-26' AND package_lpa = (SELECT MAX(package_lpa) FROM placement_drives WHERE academic_year = '2025-26')
SELECT start_date, end_date FROM academic_calendar WHERE event LIKE 'End-semester examination%' AND 'TE' = ANY(string_to_array(applies_to, ','))
SELECT replace(event, ' (holiday)', ''), start_date FROM academic_calendar WHERE event ILIKE '%holiday%' AND start_date > DATE '2026-11-23' ORDER BY start_date LIMIT 1
SELECT d.closes_on FROM grant_deadlines d JOIN grants g USING (grant_id) WHERE g.grant_name = 'Women in Tech Research Grant'

WITH me AS (SELECT s.year_of_study, s.branch, s.gender, s.cgpa, s.active_backlogs, (SELECT MIN(e.attendance_pct) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id AND e.status = 'ongoing') AS min_attendance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fee_ledger f WHERE f.student_id = s.student_id AND f.status = 'overdue') AS overdue_fees FROM students s WHERE s.student_id = '23ENTC008') SELECT me.*, g.grant_name, d.closes_on FROM me CROSS JOIN grants g JOIN grant_deadlines d USING (grant_id) WHERE DATE '2026-11-23' BETWEEN d.opens_on AND d.closes_on

WITH me AS (SELECT s.year_of_study, s.branch, s.gender, s.cgpa, s.active_backlogs, (SELECT MIN(e.attendance_pct) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id AND e.status = 'ongoing') AS min_attendance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fee_ledger f WHERE f.student_id = s.student_id AND f.status = 'overdue') AS overdue_fees FROM students s WHERE s.student_id = '23ENTC005'), dues AS (SELECT fee_type, amount_due - amount_paid AS unpaid FROM fee_ledger WHERE student_id = '23ENTC005' AND status = 'overdue') SELECT me.*, dues.fee_type, dues.unpaid, g.grant_name, d.closes_on FROM me CROSS JOIN dues CROSS JOIN grants g JOIN grant_deadlines d USING (grant_id) WHERE DATE '2026-11-23' BETWEEN d.opens_on AND d.closes_on

SELECT f.fee_type, f.amount_due - f.amount_paid AS unpaid, f.status, (SELECT MIN(e.attendance_pct) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = f.student_id AND e.status = 'ongoing') AS min_attendance FROM fee_ledger f WHERE f.student_id = '25IT013' AND f.academic_year = '2026-27' AND f.status <> 'paid'

SELECT c.title, e.attendance_pct, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fee_ledger f WHERE f.student_id = e.student_id AND f.status = 'overdue') AS overdue_fees FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c USING (course_code) WHERE e.student_id = '23CE003' AND e.status = 'ongoing'

SELECT s.year_of_study, s.branch, s.cgpa, s.active_backlogs, (SELECT MIN(e.attendance_pct) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id AND e.status = 'ongoing') AS min_attendance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fee_ledger f WHERE f.student_id = s.student_id AND f.status = 'overdue') AS overdue_fees, c.title, e.status, e.grade_letter, e.ise_marks, d.opens_on, d.closes_on FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN courses c USING (course_code) JOIN grants g ON g.grant_name = 'AI and Data Research Fellowship' JOIN grant_deadlines d ON d.grant_id = g.grant_id WHERE s.student_id = '24IT002' AND c.title = 'Data Science'

SELECT s.year_of_study, s.branch, s.cgpa, s.active_backlogs, (SELECT MIN(e.attendance_pct) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id AND e.status = 'ongoing') AS min_attendance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fee_ledger f WHERE f.student_id = s.student_id AND f.status = 'overdue') AS overdue_fees, c.title, e.status, e.grade_letter, e.ise_marks, d.opens_on, d.closes_on FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN courses c USING (course_code) JOIN grants g ON g.grant_name = 'AI and Data Research Fellowship' JOIN grant_deadlines d ON d.grant_id = g.grant_id WHERE s.student_id = '23CE020' AND c.title = 'Machine Learning'

SELECT s.year_of_study, s.cgpa, s.active_backlogs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fee_ledger f WHERE f.student_id = s.student_id AND f.status = 'overdue') AS overdue_fees FROM students s WHERE s.student_id = '23CE004'

SELECT r.cgpa, r.branch_rank, s.year_of_study, s.active_backlogs, (SELECT MIN(e.attendance_pct) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id AND e.status = 'ongoing') AS min_attendance, (SELECT c.title FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c USING (course_code) WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id AND e.status = 'ongoing' ORDER BY e.attendance_pct LIMIT 1) AS lowest_attendance_course, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fee_ledger f WHERE f.student_id = s.student_id AND f.status = 'overdue') AS overdue_fees FROM student_branch_rank r JOIN students s USING (student_id) WHERE r.student_id = '24ENTC003'
